output_schema: Dictionary keyed by canonical asset_id; value includes source_sha256, slots[].selected_slot_path, slots[].chain, reused contact receipt, ready=false and originals_changed=false.
diagnostic_fields: Every material/instance chain path and package SHA
Effective scalar and texture parameters for each instance
Base blend mode, two-sided state, opacity mask clip and instancing usage
Referenced textures with exact native paths/package SHAs
Reused native contact measurement; no recreated per-model proof
bank_return_receipts: Exact NATIVE_MATERIAL_DIAGNOSTICS.json path and file SHA after successful collection
Bank-owned invocation receipt with actual PID30328, original world, latest lease, current EDITOR_ACQUIRED PID/world, reviewed loaded source paths/hashes, manifest SHA and official paused state
Exact dirty package/map state before and after; collector must pass unchanged-dirty-state guard before publishing output
Any actual native Lit leaf-visibility observation/image and its asset/source identity, separately from graph diagnosis
Exact proposed evidence-bound material edits and diagnosis SHA before executing retained derivative repairs; keep ready=false until actual contact/facing/material validation
current_lease_limit: Last recorded lease is CODEX_MANAGED_SYSTEMS_STARTUP, activation AWAITING_MANAGER_ACTUAL_PID. It does not pass native_bank_ops.preflight. The bank needs manager-issued bank ownership and a fresh PID30328 EDITOR_ACQUIRED checkpoint before invoking the collector. Mutating entries additionally require MANAGER_ACTIVATED and no dirty vendor vegetation.
preserved: All source/vendor originals, palms, explicit holds, rights, styles and Plant07 diagnosis requirement.
